text: Fabric & Real-Time Analytics Lesson 64 had you size a Fabric Capacity by hand in the Portal, choosing an SKU like F64 based on expected load. This lesson takes that same choice and writes it as a real Terraform resource block.

azurerm_fabric_capacity takes a resource group, a location, and a sku block — name is the F-SKU you already know how to choose, F2 through F2048, and tier is always "Fabric". Only how you write the choice down changes.

administration_members is marked optional, but a capacity with nobody listed is a capacity nobody can manage after apply finishes. Each entry needs a real Entra UPN or service principal object ID — pull it from a data source instead of hardcoding a name.

This resource type is recent, wrapping a Microsoft.Fabric ARM API that itself only reached general availability recently. An older tutorial or a provider version pinned a year or two back may not have it yet — check your required_providers version first.
The SKU choice from Lesson 64, now a resource block. Next up: an Event Hub namespace and Event Hub, the same way.
